proposal.goal: Advance Chu-kei Insight from the current broad-coverage state toward full production graduation. Prioritize company-count coverage across the intended listed-company universe over deep-detail completeness for a small subset. Use official or first-party evidence, reduce unresolved/not-checked plan-detection coverage without inventing no-plan conclusions, close machine-resolvable quality gaps, align canonical repository data with the public product, and harden bounded resumable ingestion/validation/runtime paths. Preserve provenance, plan/version/period/fiscal/currentness semantics and all existing human-only review boundaries. Do not stop merely because one batch or phase finishes; this campaign should deliver the highest-value bounded work toward the completion contract in .autodev/completion-goal.json.
